mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND name LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT board_id::TEXT AS row_id, name AS board_name, type_cd, description, list_cnt, file_yn, file_cnt_limit, file_size_limit_mb, notice_yn, new_cnt, use_yn FROM board WHERE board_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT board_id::TEXT AS row_id, name AS board_name FROM board WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY board_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (name, type_cd, description, list_cnt, file_yn, file_cnt_limit, file_size_limit_mb, notice_yn, new_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{boardName}, #{typeCd}, #{description}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{listCnt}, '')::integer, 10), COALESCE(#{fileYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileCntLimit}, '')::integer, 5), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileSizeLimitMb}, '')::integer, 10), COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{newCnt}, '')::integer, 0), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET name = #{boardName}, type_cd = #{typeCd}, description = #{description}, list_cnt = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{listCnt}, '')::integer, 10), file_yn = COALESCE(#{fileYn}, 'N'), file_cnt_limit = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileCntLimit}, '')::integer, 5), file_size_limit_mb = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileSizeLimitMb}, '')::integer, 10), notice_yn = COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), new_cnt = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{newCnt}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE board_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE board SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE board_id = #{rowId}::integer
